prompt: Create a production-ready 2D aquarium game sprite PNG with a TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA alpha background. Exactly ONE fish only. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their glossy bright shaded cartoon game rendering, crisp dark outline and friendly expressive eye, but do not copy their species or anatomy. Single isolated complete whole-body fish in LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, nose left, tail right, centered on landscape canvas with 5% transparent padding. Body and all fins fully uncropped. No text, no bubbles, no props, no ground shadow, no environment, no gradients outside the fish. Empty pixels must be transparent (alpha zero), not a checkerboard or a white background. Detailed species markings must remain legible at mobile thumbnail size. Species: Ember Tetra (Hyphessobrycon amandae), a delicate SLENDER small freshwater tetra, warm translucent fiery orange body with rich amber glow inside the body and red-orange fin rays, golden-orange belly, little triangular dorsal fin, small anal fin and neatly forked short tail. One large dark amber eye. Uniform orange-red fish with NO blue, NO horizontal neon stripe, NO black body wedge. The compact narrow tetra silhouette is essential.
